cards.title: The datetime module
cards.body_tr: Tarih ve saat işleri için `datetime` modülü var. Dört ana parçası: `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `timedelta`. Hepsini sırayla göreceğiz.
cards.body: The `datetime` module handles dates and times. Its four main pieces: `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `timedelta`. We will meet each.
cards.code:
import datetime

print('date' in dir(datetime), 'timedelta' in dir(datetime))

cards.title: The current time
cards.body_tr: `datetime.now()` şu anı verir; `.year`, `.month`, `.day`, `.hour`, `.minute`, `.second` ile parçalarına ulaşılır. `.timestamp()` 1 Ocak 1970 UTC'den beri geçen saniyedir. Sonuç her an değiştiği için burada türleri ve sınırları kontrol ediyoruz.
cards.body: `datetime.now()` gives the present moment; use `.year`, `.month`, `.day`, `.hour`, `.minute`, `.second` for parts. `.timestamp()` is seconds since 1 Jan 1970 UTC. It changes every moment, so we check types and ranges.
cards.code:
from datetime import datetime

now = datetime.now()
print(type(now).__name__)
print(now.year >= 2024, 1 <= now.month <= 12)
print(type(now.timestamp()).__name__)

cards.why: That is exactly a Unix timestamp.

cards.title: Create a specific date
cards.body_tr: `datetime(yıl, ay, gün, saat, dakika, saniye)` ile kendi tarihini yaratırsın. Verilmeyen saat bilgileri 0 olur.
cards.body: `datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)` builds your own date. Missing time parts default to 0.
cards.code:
from datetime import datetime

new_year = datetime(2020, 1, 1)
print(new_year)
print(new_year.day, new_year.month, new_year.year, new_year.hour)

cards.title: strftime: date to text
cards.body_tr: `strftime(biçim)` tarihi istediğin görünüme sokar. `%d` gün, `%m` ay, `%Y` yıl, `%H:%M:%S` saat:dakika:saniye. Aynı tarih, iki farklı sıra.
cards.body: `strftime(format)` renders a date your way. `%d` day, `%m` month, `%Y` year, `%H:%M:%S` time. Same date, two orders.
cards.code:
from datetime import datetime

t = datetime(2022, 6, 28, 18, 21, 40)
print(t.strftime('%H:%M:%S'))
print(t.strftime('%m/%d/%Y, %H:%M:%S'))
print(t.strftime('%d/%m/%Y, %H:%M:%S'))

cards.why: `%d` is the day (09), `%m` the month (03), `%Y` the year.

cards.title: strptime: text to date
cards.body_tr: `strptime(yazı, biçim)` ters yönde çalışır: yazıyı `datetime` nesnesine çevirir. Biçim yazıyla birebir uymalı. `%B` ay adı.
cards.body: `strptime(text, format)` goes the other way: text to a `datetime`. The format must match the text exactly. `%B` is the month name.
cards.code:
from datetime import datetime

date_string = '5 December, 2019'
date_object = datetime.strptime(date_string, '%d %B, %Y')
print(date_object)

from datetime import datetime

d = datetime.strptime('2020-02-14', '%Y-%m-%d')
print(d.month)
cards.why: By the format the month is 02.

cards.statement: `strftime` turns a date into text, `strptime` turns text into a date.

cards.title: date: date only
cards.body_tr: `date(yıl, ay, gün)` saat içermez. `date.today()` bugünü verir.
cards.body: `date(year, month, day)` has no time part. `date.today()` gives today.
cards.code:
from datetime import date

d = date(2020, 1, 1)
print(d)
today = date.today()
print(today.year >= 2024)

cards.title: time: time of day only
cards.body_tr: `time(saat, dakika, saniye, mikrosaniye)`; hepsi isteğe bağlı, verilmeyen 0 olur.
cards.body: `time(hour, minute, second, microsecond)`; all optional, missing ones are 0.
cards.code:
from datetime import time

print(time())
print(time(10, 30, 50))
print(time(hour=10, minute=30, second=50))
print(time(10, 30, 50, 200555))

cards.why_tr: Eksik saniye 0 olur, her parça iki haneli yazılır.
cards.why: Missing seconds become 0 and each part is two digits.

cards.section: Difference Between Two Points in Time Using
cards.title: Difference between two dates
cards.body_tr: İki tarihi çıkarırsan `timedelta` (süre) elde edersin. `date` farkı gün, `datetime` farkı gün ve saat verir.
cards.body: Subtracting two dates gives a `timedelta` (duration). A `date` difference gives days; a `datetime` difference gives days and time.
cards.code:
from datetime import date, datetime

today = date(2019, 12, 5)
new_year = date(2020, 1, 1)
print(new_year - today)
t1 = datetime(2019, 12, 5, 0, 59, 0)
t2 = datetime(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
print(t2 - t1)

cards.section: Difference Between Two Points in Time Using
cards.code:
from datetime import date

print((date(2024, 3, 1) - date(2024, 2, 1)).days)
cards.why: 2024 is a leap year; February has 29 days.

cards.section: Difference Between Two Points in Time Using *timedelta*
cards.title: Durations with timedelta
cards.body_tr: `timedelta(weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds...)` bir süre tanımlar; süreler çıkarılıp toplanabilir. Çıktıda gün ve saat ayrı gösterilir.
cards.body: `timedelta(weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds...)` defines a duration; durations can be added and subtracted. Output shows days and time separately.
cards.code:
from datetime import timedelta

t1 = timedelta(weeks=12, days=10, hours=4, seconds=20)
t2 = timedelta(days=7, hours=5, minutes=3, seconds=30)
print('t3 =', t1 - t2)

cards.section: Difference Between Two Points in Time Using *timedelta*
cards.code:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start = datetime(2024, 1, 1)
print(start + ___(days=10))
cards.why: Add a `timedelta` to a date to move forward.

cards.title: Summary
points_tr: Tarih çıkarmak `timedelta` verir; `timedelta` ile tarih öteleyebilirsin.
points: `datetime.now()` gives the present; `datetime(...)` builds a given date.
`strftime` formats a date as text; `strptime` parses text into a date.
`date` holds only the date, `time` only the time.
Subtracting dates gives a `timedelta`; you can shift dates with it.
